name: Gomenne_Gomenne
source:
Gomenne_Gomenne is a small fan game based on the novel "Boyfriend to death", inspired by the Kikuo song of the same name. Here you will find jokes, bloodshed, local gags and screamers, of course. 

[Copied/Edited from [url=https://heluwu.itch.io/gomenne-gomenne]Itch.io[/url]]
